tex_content.html:
The map $\varphi \mapsto \mathcal D(e^{-l_\infty }\varphi )$ is a distribution whose value on every nonnegative compactly supported smooth $\varphi $ is nonnegative.
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:distribution-d-nonpositive The product $e^{-l_\infty }\varphi $ is nonnegative, compactly supported, and Lipschitz, so the assertion is the preceding lemma with the source sign convention.
